recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if OO finalizes a later broader Observation/Condition boundaries issue or if the external ClinicalAssessment target changes again.
issue_request: FHIR-11288 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking Observation boundaries not to categorically forbid laboratory/test impressions or interpretations as Observations. The final resolution allowed such impressions/interpretations to be conveyed in Observation or DiagnosticReport while preserving the warning against using Observation for clinical diagnoses normally captured by Condition or ClinicalImpression.
initial_application: Commit e7141420d7b05d369161f95486968badc24fdfe0 applied [#11288] in source/observation/observation-introduction.xml by adding the laboratory impressions/interpretations sentence and narrowing the old diagnosis-or-clinical-assessments warning to clinical diagnosis.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. Later source changes renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment in this guidance, FHIR-50527 added/maintained the ClinicalAssessment link and is already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-16128 corrected only punctuation around the FHIR-11288 sentence. Community searches found no directly relevant conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/observation/observation-introduction.xml already says clinical diagnoses belong with Condition/ClinicalAssessment while laboratory impressions/interpretations may be conveyed in Observation or DiagnosticReport.
